beats.say: 2010. McLaren arrived with something rivals couldn't see at first. They called it the F-duct.
On the straight, the driver covered a hole in the cockpit with his knee. That sent air to the rear wing, and stalled it.
Less drag, more top speed. In the corners, he moved his knee away, and the grip came back.
Doosri teams ne copy kiya. Phir sab teams ne milkar ise ban kar diya.
beats.cap: Other teams copied it. Then all the teams agreed to ban it.

beats.say: But the idea lived on. For 2011, F1 replaced it with a button. You know it as DRS.
Now the best story of all. December 2008. Honda quits Formula 1.
Team boss Ross Brawn takes over the team. The reported price? One pound.
Hidden in its car was a loophole: a double diffuser. Extra channels under the floor sucked the car onto the track.
lines: more grip from under the floor

beats.say: Jenson Button won six of the first seven races.
Ek pound ki team. Aur dono world championship.
beats.cap: A one-pound team. And both world championships.

beats.say: That November, Mercedes bought most of it. The one-pound team became Mercedes, and won eight constructors' titles in a row.
And that same Mercedes team brings us trick number six. February 2020, testing in Barcelona.
Onboard cameras caught the driver pulling the steering wheel towards him on the straight.
Push or pull the wheel, and the angle of the front tyres changed. They called it DAS. Dual Axis Steering.
lines: push or pull to change the tyre angle

beats.say: Yeh poori tarah legal tha. Lekin sirf ek saal ke liye.
beats.cap: It was completely legal. But only for one year.

beats.say: So why does F1 keep banning its best ideas? Usually it's cost, safety, or rivals who can't keep up.
But here's the twist. The F-duct's idea, a wing that changes on the straight, led to DRS.
And in 2026, both wings now move. Straight mode for speed, corner mode for grip.
Jo idea kabhi ban hua tha, aaj wahi rulebook mein hai.
beats.cap: The idea that was once banned is in the rulebook today.

beats.say: Next Friday: the IPL team that played just one season, and then vanished. Subscribe so you don't miss it.
And tell us in the comments. Which banned trick should come back? The fan car, or six wheels?
